cohort: 400 women who delivered at the Gynecology and Obstetrics Department B of Charles Nicolle Hospital in Tunis, Tunisia, between November 1, 2023, and February 29, 2024.
finding: Breastfeeding continuation at 12 months was significantly associated with early initiation and negatively influenced by maternal obesity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery showed no significant impact on breastfeeding duration.
cross-section timing: Data collected from November 1, 2023, to February 29, 2024.
